subject.title: RFC: Org claim disputes and account recovery

question: What minimum evidence, decision factors, deleted-owner reservation rules, and self-deleted-account recovery eligibility should ClawHub formally guarantee?
rationale: Current main provides safe intake and guarded operations, but permanent identity-transfer, authorization, abuse-prevention, and sensitive-evidence rules require explicit maintainer intent.
